text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel hasn't shown up for training...
Thinking something might have happened,
I search the academy—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, this makes no sense after all.
Maybe I'm just interpreting it wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Um... while translating a French book, I came across a sentence that just didn't make any sense...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I got so stubborn with researching that it's already this late...

Sakura Laurel seems truly remorseful.
I reminded her to be more careful from now on.
